title: Sheep eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='22' fill='#f7f4e8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='14' fill='#fffdf4'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='48' r='14' fill='#fffdf4'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='62' r='13' fill='#f0ecdd'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='65' r='12' fill='#f0ecdd'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='12' fill='#fffdf4'/>
  <!-- wool texture -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='55' r='6' fill='#e3ddc9' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='5' fill='#e3ddc9' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='5' fill='#e3ddc9' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='6' height='13' rx='2' fill='#6b5a4a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='76' width='6' height='13' rx='2' fill='#6b5a4a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='86' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4d3f33'/>
  <rect x='46' y='86' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4d3f33'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='54' r='16' fill='#d9c3a5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='10' fill='#c9b190'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d9c3a5' transform='rotate(-25 60 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d9c3a5' transform='rotate(25 82 44)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='3' fill='#3a2e24'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='3' fill='#3a2e24'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8a6f58'/>
  <!-- mouth open eating snack -->
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='64' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5e4030'/>
  <!-- snack: green leaf/cracker -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='62' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ec850' transform='rotate(-15 88 62)'/>
  <path d='M83 62 Q88 58 93 62' stroke='#5aa83a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='60' r='1' fill='#5aa83a'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='61' r='1' fill='#5aa83a'/>
  <!-- little crumbs -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#e8c15a'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='70' r='1.2' fill='#e8c15a'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='56' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='60' r='6' fill='#fffdf4'/>
</svg>
